mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (id, agent_id, title, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{title}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, title, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, created_at FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, agent_id, title, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, created_at FROM tasks WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
